description: This file defines the `MathArithmeticException` class, a custom exception class used as a base for arithmetic-related exceptions in the Apache Commons Math library. It extends `ArithmeticException` and implements additional context handling for localization and detailed messaging.

classes.name: MathArithmeticException
classes.description: A base class for arithmetic exceptions that provides localized messages and context information, extending the standard `ArithmeticException`.

methods.name: MathArithmeticException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception context with a default arithmetic exception message.

methods.name: MathArithmeticException(Localizable pattern, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a localizable message pattern and arguments to provide detailed, localized error messaging.

methods.name: getContext()
methods.description: Returns the ExceptionContext associated with this exception, containing message details.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Returns the message from the ExceptionContext, providing a localized error message.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage()
methods.description: Returns the localized message from the ExceptionContext.
